description: This PHP source file defines the class PsrHttpFactoryHelper within the namespace OrangeHRM\OAuth\Service. The class provides utility methods to convert between PSR-7 HTTP message interfaces and Symfony HTTP foundation request and response objects, facilitating interoperability between Symfony and PSR-7 standards in the OrangeHRM OAuth plugin.

classes.name: PsrHttpFactoryHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing methods to convert between Symfony HttpFoundation requests/responses and PSR-7 requests/responses using Symfony's PsrHttpMessage bridges.

methods.name: getPsrHttpFactory
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns a PsrHttpFactory instance with a default PSR-17 factory.

methods.name: getHttpFoundationFactory
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an HttpFoundationFactory instance.

methods.name: createPsr7Request
methods.description: Creates a PSR-7 ServerRequestInterface object from a Symfony Request object.

methods.name: createPsr7Response
methods.description: Creates a PSR-7 ResponseInterface object from a Symfony Response object.

methods.name: createRequestFromPsr7Request
methods.description: Creates a Symfony Request object from a PSR-7 ServerRequestInterface object.

methods.name: createResponseFromPsr7Response
methods.description: Creates a Symfony Response object from a PSR-7 ResponseInterface object.
